name: Software Product Template
description: Template for software libraries, services, and applications

suggestedColors.name: design
suggestedColors.description: Code modules, classes, functions, API definitions

suggestedColors.name: verification
suggestedColors.description: Unit tests, integration tests, test suites

sketchDesignQuestions: What is the top-level application/service name and its major components?
What is the module/package structure of the codebase?
What are the key classes and their relationships?
What APIs are exposed (REST endpoints, gRPC services, etc.)?
What data models/schemas exist (database tables, message formats)?
What are the external dependencies and how are they managed?
What test suites exist and how are they organized?
What requirements or user stories drive the features?
Where is the source code hosted and how is it structured?
What deployment configurations exist (containers, services, environments)?
